fn Power2(exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (2 * Power2((exp - 1)))))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (Power2(0) == 1)
  example (Power2(1) == 2)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (2 * Power2((exp - 1)))

fn RightShift(x1: List[Int], x2: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(x1) == len(x2))
  requires forall i in 0..len(x2): (x2[i] >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(x1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not (x1[i] >= 0)) or (result[i] == (x1[i] / Power2(x2[i]))))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not (x1[i] < 0)) or (result[i] == (x1[i] / Power2(x2[i]))))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not (x2[i] == 0)) or (result[i] == x1[i]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((((not (x1[i] > 0)) or (result[i] >= 0)) and ((not (x1[i] < 0)) or (result[i] <= 0))) and ((not (x1[i] == 0)) or (result[i] == 0)))

  effects pure
  example (RightShift([], []) == [])
